XCAPITOLO.Corpo: The battery is located in the engine compartment, on the driver's side, near the bulkhead.

If the battery needs to be disconnected, it is necessary to:

  • Check that all electrical devices in the car, such as the car radio, sat nav, etc., are switched off
  • Check that the ignition is switched off
  • Have the radio code available

    You can then proceed to disconnect the battery, removing the negative terminal first and then the positive terminal

    After disconnecting the battery, wait a few minutes before working on the airbag system.

To reconnect the battery, proceed as follows:

  • First connect the positive terminal and then the negative terminal of the battery
  • Reset the radio code (if necessary)
  • Clear any errors in the memory
  • Turn on the ignition and wait 40 seconds
  • Turn off the ignition
  • The stability control system warning lights may come on. You will need to drive the vehicle for a few kilometres at a constant speed for these to go out.

Electric window initialisation procedure:

  • Check that the doors and windows are closed .
  • Turn on the ignition
  • Press the electric window open/close button and hold it down until the window is fully open
  • Release the electric window open/close button and hold it up for more than 3 seconds after it has closed completely
  • You will hear an acoustic signal confirming that the operation has been completed

    The system is now initialised.
    Repeat the procedure for the remaining windows.
